report: ATX Lakescapes L3 work-ops research - Lake Austin sediment removal

bathymetric_data.name: TWDB Lake Austin & Lady Bird Lake underwater contour lines (ArcGIS item)
LCRA Hydromet (levels only, no depth maps)

bathymetry.notes: No public bathymetric survey newer than TWDB 2008 found. Lake is a constant-level pass-through reservoir; 2017 drawdown was -10 ft (to ~481.2-482.8 ft).

permits.rule: COA LDC 25-8-652 - dredging/fill in Lake Austin prohibited except as provided
permits.summary: Baseline prohibition on dredging or placing fill in Lake Austin; exceptions via administrative approval.

permits.rule: COA administrative dredging approval <25 cubic yards per address (navigation safety)
permits.summary: Director may approve <25 cy dredging per address; confirmed in 2025 Board of Adjustment cases. Larger per-address volumes effectively barred.

permits.rule: COA site plan exemption (drawdown) vs engineer-sealed site plan (normal pool)
permits.agency: City of Austin DSD / Development Assistance Center 512-974-6370
permits.summary: <=25 cy slip cleanout during drawdown may proceed under site plan exemption; spoil must leave floodplain; wetlands avoided. Wet-season dredging requires full site plan.

During announced drawdowns, registered owners may do maintenance dredging up to 2,000 cy and repair walls/slips/ramps under LCRA's USACE Lakewide Permit; permit notice posted onsite; no burning in lakebed. Lake Austin 2026 drawdown not confirmed; LCRA now schedules drawdowns in fall.

permits.rule: Highland Lakes Dredge and Fill Ordinance (eff. 2022-01-01)
permits.summary: Tier I <500 cy/<500 lf = notification; Tier II >=500 cy or >=500 lf = LCRA permit; Tier III commercial dredging allowed only in zones on lakes Buchanan and LBJ (none on Lake Austin). Applicability of HLDO tiers to Lake Austin is ambiguous - LCRA elsewhere assigns Lake Austin dredge jurisdiction to City of Austin. Confirm with LCRA 512-578-2324.

Mechanical dredging with any discharge in Lake Austin (Water of the US) needs 404 authorization; typically covered by LCRA programmatic/lakewide general permits during drawdowns; otherwise NWP or individual permit.

permits.rule: CWA Section 401 Water Quality Certification (30 TAC 279)
permits.summary: Companion to any 404 permit. Tier I (<3 ac/<1500 lf): waived with TCEQ BMPs incl turbidity control; Tier II: individual certification. Contact 401Certs@tceq.texas.gov.
SWPPP + erosion controls required for upland disturbance >=1 acre (staging/dewatering yards, access).
Right to dredge depends on ownership or permission for the submerged tract; COA is primary shoreline regulator on Lake Austin; verify title per tract.
COA 2025-10-10 memo: working group exploring potential 2026 drawdown (~10 ft, ~6 weeks); fall timing per ERCOT guidance; not confirmed as of 2026-07-27.

disposal.name: WM Austin Community Landfill (MSW 249D)
disposal.acceptance: Non-hazardous waste; dewatered spoil likely accepted - call-first to confirm profile/rates

disposal.name: Texas Disposal Systems Landfill (MSW 2123)
disposal.acceptance: Clean dirt/sand/aggregates (debris-free) accepted; sludge/special waste by approval; $60/ton MSW-C&D 2-ton min (2025); M-Sat 7-7; no liquids

disposal.name: Williamson County Recycling & Disposal Facility (WM, MSW 1405B)
Marcelo's Dump Site
disposal.acceptance: Sand/gravel/loam/dirt/topsoil/rock<24in; NO liquids, wood, trash, concrete; good for dewatered clean sediment

disposal.name: Beneficial reuse as clean fill (private sites)
disposal.acceptance: Uncontaminated sediment reusable as fill; document origin; keep out of floodplain/wetlands

removal_zones.name: Lower Lake

removal_zones.name: 360-Bull Creek arm
removal_zones.reach: Loop 360 bridge to Bull Creek mouth (Party Cove delta)
removal_zones.notes: Signature Bull Creek delta hot spot; 24-hr ramp; limited trailer parking - stage at Emma Long

removal_zones.name: Mid Lake
removal_zones.reach: 360 bridge to Emma Long/Commons Ford bend, incl Bee Creek arm
removal_zones.notes: Bee Creek delta; Emma Long lot is best truck/dewatering staging on lake

removal_zones.name: North-shore mid-upper

removal_zones.notes: Interior silting independent of main lake; POA permission mandatory; likely land-based excavation during drawdown
